title: Foliar silicate and wheat yield (WORKED EXAMPLE — synthetic)

axes.question: Does foliar silicate increase grain yield of drought-stressed wheat in field trials?
axes.boundary: H1 requires field evidence at a stated rate. H2 requires field evidence that the effect is absent. H3 applies when the field evidence is mixed.
axes.scope: Wheat grown in field trials under drought.

hypotheses.title: Foliar silicate raises field yield under drought
hypotheses.statement: Foliar silicate increases grain yield of drought-stressed wheat in field trials. The increase is reported at a foliar rate of two millilitres per litre. The yield increase is larger when drought is severe.
hypotheses.assumptions: The foliar rate is two millilitres per litre and the trials are conducted under drought.
hypotheses.falsification: Field trials at that rate report no yield difference.
hypotheses.corroboration: Field trials at that rate report a larger yield increase when drought is severe.

hypotheses.title: The field yield effect is absent
hypotheses.statement: Foliar silicate does not increase grain yield of drought-stressed wheat in field trials. Field trials at a foliar rate of two millilitres per litre report no yield difference.
hypotheses.assumptions: The null trials used the same foliar rate of two millilitres per litre.
hypotheses.falsification: A field trial at that rate reports a yield increase.
hypotheses.corroboration: Multi-site field trials report no yield difference at that rate.

hypotheses.title: The field evidence is inconsistent
hypotheses.statement: Existing field evidence cannot determine whether foliar silicate increases grain yield of drought-stressed wheat under drought. The field findings are inconsistent across trials.
hypotheses.assumptions: Field trials at a comparable rate have been retrieved.
hypotheses.falsification: Consistent field trials establish either a yield benefit or its absence at that rate.
hypotheses.corroboration: Field findings differ across trials without a clear rate or timing explanation.

mission:
## 1. Mission

Test whether a foliar silicate treatment increases grain yield of drought-stressed
wheat in field trials.
